scientific_integrity: The general statement is proved by a null-inclusion homotopy pushout and a signed Lefschetz-cycle enumeration. Exact finite tests support but do not certify the universal theorem.
scientific_limitations: The sphere wedge is nonequivariant; the general group-action conclusion is a rational character, not an integral lattice description except when all parts have two vertices; indexed priority comparisons cannot exclude unindexed prior calculations. Higher tolerance levels are not covered.
title: One-tolerance multipartite joins: sphere ranks and full automorphism characters
